create_forest_feature_importances: create a random forest classifier and compute impurity-based feature importances on a synthetic dataset
run_permutation_importance: run permutation-based feature importance on a fitted random forest model using a held-out test set
build_feature_importance_plot: build a bar plot of feature importances with error bars showing inter-tree variability
generate_classification_dataset: generate a synthetic classification dataset with configurable informative and redundant features
split_train_test_dataset: split a dataset into stratified training and testing subsets for model evaluation
